iso_retirement.comment:
Speakers of each proposed separate language only have marginal understanding of
the other languages. There is no central variety that speakers of the proposed
languages understand.
iso_retirement.name: Northern Zhuang
iso_retirement.remedy: Split into ten languages: Guibian Zh [zgn]; Liujiang Zh [zlj]; Qiubei Zh [zqe]; Guibei Zh [zgb]; Youjiang Zh [zyj]; Central Hongshuihe Zh [zch]; Eastern Hongshuihe Zh [zeh]; Liuqian Zh [zlq]; Yongbei Zh [zyb]; Lianshan Zh [zln].
